leads.title: Constitution of Paraguay (1992), Articles 49, 50, 51, 52
leads.documents: Limits marriage, de facto unions and family to 'one man and one woman'; basis for non-recognition of same-sex couples.
leads.detail: Cited as Article 49 'Protection of the Family', Article 50 'Right To Constitute a Family', Article 51 'Legal Marriages and the Effects of De Facto Unions', Article 52 'Union in Marriage' - in force since 1992

leads.title: Paraguayan Civil Code, Article 140 and Article 42
leads.documents: Article 140 expressly prohibits marriage between persons of same sex; Article 42 allows change of first name, cited as basis for transgender name-change lawsuits.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Article 140 of the Paraguayan Civil Code' and 'article 42 of the Civil Code that allows the change of first name'

leads.title: Inter-American Court of Human Rights (IACHR) Advisory Opinion OC-24/17
leads.documents: Requires states party to American Convention on Human Rights, including Paraguay, to grant same-sex couples access to marriage and all rights deriving from marriage.
leads.detail: Cited as issued 8 January 2018 / 9 January 2018 advisory opinion; basis for SOMOSGAY petition to Supreme Court of Justice announced 12 January 2018

leads.title: Law 5162/2014 Criminal Enforcement Code, Article 274
leads.documents: Requires age, sexual orientation and degree of psychic development be considered when housing adolescents in collective dormitories.
leads.detail: Cited as Title II on Execution of measures imposed on adolescents, Chapter III, part of article 274

leads.title: Decree 6973 regulating Law 577/2016 on Comprehensive protection of women against all forms of violence, Article 3
leads.documents: Establishes protection of women in situations of violence without discrimination based on sexual orientation.
leads.detail: Cited as article 3 on 'Protected persons' of Decree 6973

leads.title: Law 6149/2018 on Protection and Facilities for the Naturalization of Stateless Persons, Article 9
leads.documents: Guarantees rights under the law without discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity.

leads.title: Law 6534/2020 on the Protection of Personal Credit Data, Article 3(b)
leads.documents: Defines data revealing preference or sexual orientation as sensitive personal data with protection against discriminatory misuse.
leads.detail: Cited as article 3(b) definition of sensitive personal data

leads.title: Ministry of Public Health and Social Welfare Resolution 695 (Resolucion 695), October 2016
leads.documents: Allows transgender people to use social name on medical records/history/forms and requires health service staff to treat them with that name.
leads.detail: Cited as approved October 2016; applies to Integrated Networks of Health Services (RIISS)

leads.title: Law 7018 on Mental Health, Article 3
leads.documents: Prohibits mental health diagnosis made exclusively on basis of sexual choice or identity; relevant to conversion therapy.

leads.title: Internal Rules and Regulations of the Ministry of Public Defense, Article 28
leads.documents: Prohibits discrimination based on sexual orientation against employees of the Defense Ministry.
leads.detail: Cited as Article 28 of Reglamento Interno del Ministerio de la Defensa Publica
